cover.sub: MAPS · GEAR · ELITE PERKS · MODES · SWITCH 2

slides.title: 2 NEW MAPS

cards.name: Hajin
cards.desc: First Warzone map in Korea: 13 major POIs across North + South Korea, with changing weather.

cards.name: Zodiac
cards.desc: Drone factory with 10 POIs, moving trains on a double railway + underground tunnels.

cards.name: Hajin Gulag
cards.desc: 2 symmetrical arenas exposed to weather. Spectate from ground level.

slides.foot: VERDANSK + REBIRTH ISLAND RETURN LATER IN SEASON 1

slides.title: WHAT CHANGES
rules: Player level resets: level up + optional Prestige across MP, DMZ and Warzone.
All 33 launch guns + S1 weapons, Apex attachments + Warzone mastery camos.
Free for everyone, no perk needed (slightly shorter).
You can now drag teammates while reviving them.

slides.title: NEW GEAR

cards.name: Zipline Launcher
cards.desc: Fire anchors + zip roof to roof. Enemies can use your line too. Pistols work on it.

cards.name: Grabber Drone
cards.desc: Claw drone: grabs loot, fuel barrels or a downed teammate for the revive. Limited battery.

cards.name: Weapon Augments
cards.desc: From 'Fly Buy' Buy Stations, limited: CQC, Marksman or Handling boost for that match.

slides.foot: ALSO NEW: PERK SUPPLY BOX · RAZOR WIRE · SAM TURRET · SMOKE WALL

slides.title: ELITE PERKS
rules: More agile when strafing, crouching + in ADS. Smaller jump/slide ADS penalty.
Undetectable by enemy recon killstreaks, equipment and perks.
Buy Stations or Supply Run contracts. Only one Elite Perk at a time.

slides.sec: FIND OR BUY THEM IN MATCH
slides.title: NEW KILLSTREAKS

cards.name: Bomb Glider
cards.desc: Hand-held glider with an explosive payload.

cards.name: Impact Warhead
cards.desc: Explosive payload that drills through multiple floors.

cards.name: Artillery Beacon
cards.desc: Heat-seeking missiles track the beacon you deploy.

slides.foot: ALSO NEW: BOMBING RUN · UAV, CUAV + ADVANCED UAV RETURN

slides.title: 3 NEW MODES
rules: Zodiac, 20 players, no circle, drop in/out anytime. Rumor: a buyable Nuke.
Hajin, 120 players, Resurgence on the big map.
Zodiac + Rebirth, 44 players: your own loadout, keep your guns after death.

slides.title: SWITCH 2 + MORE
rules: Warzone launches on Nintendo Switch 2, its first time on a Nintendo console.
No longer playable. Progress carries over with your linked Activision account.
Return to Warzone event: Renaissance (animated), Violet Striker, Neutral Ground.
Warzone mastery camos: Parallax › Damascus Reforged › Empyros.

cta.sub: HAJIN OR ZODIAC: WHERE DO YOU DROP?
